title: The water-rich share of rocky and water planets against mass in the Bern population synthesis (GEN.510)
source: Bern NGPPS NG76 nominal population (Zenodo 10527170, open, no licence field), window 0.5 < P < 100 d and 0 < R < 20 Earth radii, 5 Gyr: 2554 planets, 1727 rock, 502 water (envelope fully water), 325 H/He. Fractions of water among rock and water, COMPUTED by the group 2 worker of the tunable-gaps investigation (docs/design/composition/tunable-gaps-sources/group2-delivery-retention.md section 2.2).
label: COMPUTED
note: A MODEL result of a physics simulation, not a measurement. Only the first bin states its count in the report. 'sigma' is the root mean square of the logistic's residuals against the six bins (COMPUTED here), the tolerance a test uses.
